boundary: Research priority only; no buy/sell advice and no rebalance action.

priority_rules.P0: Affects downstream action advice: bond/cash tool, high-weight unprofiled ETF, concentrated unprofiled theme, or unprofiled stock near 2% weight.

priority_rules.P2: Small weight below 1% or lower immediate impact.
